ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift
ordered_steps.summary: Audit the translator schema drift before removing the legacy parser shim. The shim currently masks drift in local smoke runs, so this audit de-risks all downstream work.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift report with identified mismatches between translator output and legacy shim expectations.

ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures
ordered_steps.summary: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures so the plan contract catches ordering regressions. Fixtures must reflect the new schema discovered in RN-101.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated fixture files that pass plan_contract.py with the new step-id schema.

ordered_steps.title: Enable dashboard summary behind kill switch
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the translated release-plan dashboard summary behind a kill switch. Only after schema is stable (RN-101) and fixtures are backfilled (RN-102).
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary feature flag behind kill switch, validated in canary.

ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist
ordered_steps.summary: Update the operator runbook and launch checklist after the summary path is proven in canary. Runbook only stabilizes after rollout and rollback shape are known.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook and launch checklist documenting rollout and rollback procedures.

dependency_notes.reason: Fixtures must reflect the new schema discovered during the schema drift audit.
Dashboard summary consumes the step-id schema produced by the translator; schema must be stable first.
Dashboard summary must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema.
Runbook only stabilizes after the rollout and rollback shape are known from canary validation.

primary_risk.statement: The release dashboard renders incorrect step ordering to operators if the dashboard summary (RN-103) ships before the schema audit (RN-101) and fixture backfill (RN-102) are complete.
mitigations: Keep the dashboard summary behind a kill switch (RN-103) so it can be disabled immediately if bad data appears.
Complete schema audit (RN-101) and fixture backfill (RN-102) before enabling the dashboard, ensuring the translator output is correct.
Validate in canary before broad rollout; canary coverage exists for dashboard summary (test_inventory.md).

assumption_ledger.note: No evidence of an existing kill switch mechanism for the dashboard summary; RN-103 assumes one exists or can be added.
Canary coverage exists but its readiness for validating the full dashboard summary path is unconfirmed.
